traits.name: Beast Speech
traits.text: The cyclops warlock can cast speak with animals at will, without expending a spell slot.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The cyclops warlock is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 10, +2 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells: * Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, true strike * 1st-2nd level (2 slots): darkness, expeditious retreat, find familiar, hex, mirror image

traits.name: Poor Depth Perception
traits.text:
The cyclops has disadvantage
on any attack roll against a target more than 30
feet away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cyclops makes two greatclub attacks.
